node.statement: First three-factor replacement. Assuming the one-factor estimate ||Phi_n(Delta_n T)-Delta_n T|| <= d||T|| and complete contractivity of Phi and Delta, put P0:=Phi_n(Delta_n X Delta_n Y Delta_n Z) and P1:=Phi_n(Phi_n(Delta_n X) Phi_n(Delta_n Y) Phi_n(Delta_n Z)); a three-term product telescope gives ||P0-P1|| <= 3d||X||||Y||||Z||.
